newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet calls general meeting for July 31.
newsitem.headline: Eramet calls general meeting for July 31.

text.p: Nickel company Eramet said in a statement on Wednesday following a board meeting that it was calling a general shareholders' meeting for July 31 and would submit a number of proposals aimed to soothe some minority shareholders.

The company, which risks losing some of its mining assets in New Caledonia because the French state wants to promote a Kanak mining venture, said it would propose a new board to the meeting. This would include three staff representatives and two "personalities from New Caledonia" which will be named soon.

It said the board would be made up of chairman Yves Ramboud, Olivier Appert, Remy Chardon, Henri Guillaume, Francois Jouven, Aimery Langlois-Meurinne, Yves Le Bars, George T. Lowy, Stig Ramel, Philippe Rouvillois, Gilbert Rutman, Wilhelm Scheider as well as Erap chairman Yves Bernard.
Erap is the state holding which has a majority in Eramet.
Eramet said the order of the meeting would be published in the official bulletin on July 16.
